status: Recommended inventory; nothing installed or benchmarked on the user machines.

tools.name: Native Windows Storage cmdlets + CIM
tools.decision: Map devices, partitions, volumes and mount paths before cleanup; reconcile provider coverage rather than trusting a drive letter.

tools.name: diskutil + tmutil
tools.agent_interface: Native command output; prefer supported machine-readable variants
tools.decision: Understand APFS container sharing and snapshots; keep capacity-pool accounting separate from per-volume logical size.

tools.name: WizTree
tools.decision: Fast local NTFS MFT scan. Elevate only the approved collector when necessary. Filename/size duplicate matches are candidates, not verified byte identity. Personal-only free licensing; commercial use needs suitable license.

tools.name: Everything + ES
tools.decision: Use as the persistent name/metadata index; do not interpret an absent result as proof a file is absent outside index coverage.

tools.name: TreeSize Professional
tools.decision: Choose instead of the default space-reporting frontend when scheduled reporting and an established operator GUI matter. Scheduling is Professional-only.

tools.name: ncdu
tools.decision: Export the tree to a file and query offline. One-filesystem scans and output depth must not be confused with total-size accuracy. Interactive deletion is not an analysis permission.

tools.name: dua-cli
tools.decision: Useful compiled scanner. APFS clone deduplication is opt-in and not a complete reclaimable-block oracle.

tools.name: czkawka_cli
tools.decision: Select exact-content hash mode for duplicate review. Similar-media detection and same-name groups must remain separate. No automatic removal.

tools.name: fclones
tools.agent_interface: JSON / CSV groups and separate action commands
tools.decision: Attractive separation of detection from action, but upstream platform caveats prevent making it the default across both target hosts.

tools.name: smartmontools smartctl
tools.decision: Collect drive identity, health, wear and errors where exposed. Missing telemetry means unsupported/unknown, not healthy. No repair or destructive tests.

tools.name: rclone
tools.tier: Core when moving data between hosts
tools.decision: Use controlled copies plus check/readback. SFTP hash capability depends on the remote backend/shell; it does not promise native metadata fidelity.

tools.name: Robocopy
tools.decision: Useful when Windows metadata matters. Preview first. Do not make mirror/purge the default; those operations can delete destination data.

tools.name: restic
tools.decision: Independent versioned backup. Windows VSS is supported with the documented option; application consistency still needs owner-aware handling. Verify repository data and actual restores.

tools.name: Syncthing
tools.decision: Not full-drive management or a backup substitute. Versioning primarily archives incoming remote changes, not every local edit.

tools.name: OpenSSH
tools.decision: Each host executes native collectors. Restrict identities and supported commands; use independent approved credentials for both directions.

tools.name: Tailscale network layer
tools.decision: Use ordinary OpenSSH over the network for symmetry. Tailscale SSH server is not supported on Windows; its macOS server requires CLI tailscaled.

tools.name: SQLite or DuckDB storage catalog
tools.decision: This is a proposed design, not a supplied service: share cached scans across agents, retain errors, scope and timestamps, and avoid flooding contexts with file trees.

tools.name: Application-owned cleanup commands; uv as verified example
tools.decision: Use supported cleanup operations rather than deleting internal cache structure. uv placement across filesystems can lose hardlink benefits.

tools.name: mamertofabian/mcp-everything-search
tools.decision: Windows Everything, macOS mdfind and Linux locate/plocate are distinct backends with different coverage. Search only; not a disk-accounting system.

tools.name: MCP filesystem reference server
tools.decision: Explicit roots plus OS permissions. This is a reference server, not proof of an audited read-only security boundary.

tools.name: dknell/mcp-system-info
tools.decision: Convenient usage and mount overview; does not replace disk topology, folder accounting or SMART telemetry.

tools.name: sandraschi/disk-usage-mcp
tools.decision: Closest existing match to the baseline: wraps dua and czkawka. Its README is not evidence of production readiness; no runtime/source audit was completed. Validate install procedure instead of trusting the pasted uvx claim.

tools.name: Desktop Commander
tools.decision: Useful if the agent lacks local shell access. Broad execution remains broad execution; do not treat settings alone as a security boundary.

tools.name: Smart Tree / Deep Directory Tree MCP
tools.decision: Useful for selected paths, not the central authority for full-machine storage accounting.
